description: Zero‑dependency, type‑safe Node.js framework that matches Express simplicity while delivering AI‑first hooks, edge‑scale speed, and native serverless deployment.
npm_trending_strategy: Version 0.0.115‑daily introduces native AI‑hooks that let you attach LLM‑driven middleware with a single line, plus built‑in OpenTelemetry tracing and a zero‑dependency runtime that works on Node, Deno, Bun, Cloudflare Workers, and WASM. The type‑safe API, ESM‑only design, and edge‑first performance put it ahead of Express/Fastify for modern, serverless‑first stacks.
download_hooks: Developers choose yantravese for AI‑first middleware that writes itself, eliminating boilerplate.
Benchmarks show sub‑millisecond routing on edge runtimes, beating Express by >10× in cold‑start scenarios.
Full TypeScript support, zero‑dependency install, and built‑in observability give a frictionless dev experience.
